notes.title: 🐻 It's LAUNCH DAY!!! 🐻
notes.content:
Today is such an exciting day for us, as we finally get to release this sweet game to the world.

Three Days to Chicago is a branching narrative visual novel, with stylized photography being the basis of the art and backgrounds. 

The game is very unique also in that it celebrates gay bears, a super fun and friendly subculture in the gay world that is often overlooked or ignored in mainstream media. Here, you play a role on a cross-country adventure and get to chance encounter a potential romance. 

[h2][i][b]If you love gay games, love stories, bears, or unique visual novels -- this game is for you![/b][/i][/h2]
